title: Sudan Anti-War Coalition and Quintet Agree Three-Track Framework in Addis Ababa
detail: Sudan's anti-war coalition met the Quintet (African Union, UN, IGAD, Arab League, EU) at AU headquarters in Addis Ababa. The proposed framework runs three parallel tracks: a temporary ceasefire, humanitarian aid delivery and comprehensive political dialogue. Both sides agreed to form a joint preparatory committee to set agendas, choose participants and venues, and widen engagement with international facilitators. The coalition objected to including the former ruling party until the former regime's economic base is dismantled and military decision-making is independent.
